captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a large-aperture Newtonian truss-tube reflector telescope mounted on a manually controlled alt-azimuth Dobsonian base. The structural components, including the ground board, rocker box, and primary mirror box, are rendered in a wood-brown material, while the secondary cage rings and altitude trunnion bearings are black, with steel-grey truss poles and a reflective blue-grey primary mirror. The primary mirror box pivots smoothly along its altitude axis inside the rocker box, which itself rotates continuously 360 degrees on a flat, triangular ground board.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a Newtonian truss-tube reflector telescope on a manual alt-azimuth Dobsonian mount. The model should include a triangular ground board, a rocker box, a primary mirror box carrying a circular mirror, eight steel truss poles, and a secondary cage with dual rings. Ensure the rocker box rotates continuously relative to the ground board, and the mirror box rotates on a revolute altitude joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs the telescope assembly hierarchically using primitive boxes and cylinders. It begins by creating a ground board using a triangular prism or flat box, followed by building the rocker box with vertical side walls. The mirror box is modeled as an open-top box containing a large cylinder representing the primary mirror. Eight thin cylinders are constructed as truss poles extending to a secondary cage composed of two coaxial ring cylinders. Connections are defined via joints: a continuous rotational joint about the Z-axis connects the ground board to the rocker box, a revolute joint about the Y-axis connects the rocker box to the mirror box, and fixed joints secure the truss poles and secondary cage.
